summary: At Doug's request every criterion was re-graded at 10ab04a under the current test-audit skill, which takes required parts from the PRD criteria and assumptions and uses the technical design only to find code. AC-SAFE-01, AC-SAFE-02, AC-SAFE-03 and AC-SAFE-04 are now Adequate, with new tests seen failing except where the only break would widen a guard on what Start writes, launches or removes. AC-SETUP-06 has one gap left; the other 13 rows remain Weak with gaps listed in order in test-audit.md, so test work continues. Doug's ruling on a pending pause was added to AC-SAFE-03 in the PRD: on an existing-branch start, the phase the run stopped on is still to run until its done check passes. The final full integration run had one failure in a test whose session could fail before waiting; that test and one like it were fixed, repeated eight times and the whole folder-setup file passes.
